open_points.subject: plan_run edge delivery rule selection
open_points.text: MUST give each EdgeState the delivery of the one imported EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES row whose source_succeeded equals whether the edge source concluded as ElementSucceeded and whose guard_present equals whether the edge has a guard;
open_points.other_text: guard_matches is false unless both source_succeeded and guard_present are true, and otherwise equals whether the canonical JSON text of the source's guard_port value equals its guard_value.
open_points.question: Must the selected EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES row also have guard_matches equal to the computed guard_matches value, or is guard_matches intentionally not part of row selection?
